Name: Shimeah, Son of Mikloth
Summary: Son of Mikloth, who dwelt with his brethren in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:32: Son of Mikloth, who dwelt with his brethren in Jerusalem.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shimeah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
